verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a Balances API that returns real-time and historical balance data for bookkeeping, and a Settlement Report that breaks each payout down into all transactions, fees and deductions to support reconciliation. Its hosted MCP server exposes both the Balances API and the Settlements API to agents such as Claude and Cursor, so an agent can pull this data directly. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the Settlements API (not just the report) lists the individual payments in each payout, documented balance-transaction-level endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven reconciliation.
